# Keep the Light 1.44.2

- **Fixed: profiles disappearing after a restart.** From about the 12th profile, new profiles and changes to profiles were not saved. You can now keep hundreds of profiles, and the window tells you if a change ever cannot be saved. (Profiles you made after hitting the limit need to be made again.)
- **When the graphics card stops responding,** Keep the Light waits 30 seconds and tries once more, then pauses the queue on that file with a plain message instead of failing every file left. Restart Windows, then press Start to carry on.
- If File Explorer still shows the old icon after updating, run `ie4uinit.exe -show` in a Command Prompt (or sign out and back in).
